description: This file is a CMake module script that provides functions and configurations for setting up and managing code coverage analysis in CMake-based projects. It includes functions to setup targets for coverage reports using lcov, gcovr, and html outputs, as well as handling compiler flags for coverage instrumentation.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_lcov
methods.description: Defines a custom target that runs tests, captures coverage data with lcov, and generates HTML reports, with options to exclude directories and control demangling.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_xml
methods.description: Creates a target to run tests and produce a Cobertura-style XML coverage report using gcovr.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_html
methods.description: Creates a target to run tests and generate an HTML coverage report using gcovr.

methods.name: append_coverage_compiler_flags
methods.description: Appends coverage-related compiler flags to C, C++, and Fortran compiler flags.
